instruction: Please change the name of the "archive_2023" directory to "archive_2024" on my desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires renaming directory from 'archive_2023' to 'archive_2024'. Evaluator checks if the renamed directory exists using shell command. This variation uses yearly archive pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Evaluator correctly checks both (1) archive_2024 exists AND (2) archive_2023 does not exist
Correct logic flow: The shell command '[ -d ~/Desktop/archive_2024 ] && [ ! -d ~/Desktop/archive_2023 ] && echo 'Renamed successfully.' || echo 'Rename failed.' properly verifies the rename operation
No false positives: The dual check prevents false positives where a user might create archive_2024 without renaming archive_2023
Appropriate metric: exact_match correctly compares the command output with the expected 'Renamed successfully.\n' string
Getter logic: get_vm_command_line properly executes the shell command and returns the output for comparison
